text: The Fed just hiked rates to 3.75%-4% while job growth collapsed to just 29,000 — this rising-rates-plus-weakening-economy combination is stagflationary and means riskier holdings face serious headwinds, so tighten your overall risk exposure now.
RGTI is down 75% from its high with negative earnings, revenue shrinking 34%, and heavy short interest — there's no fundamental reason to stay in this, sell and free up capital.
QBTS is down 61% with the weakest relative strength in your portfolio, no earnings, 24% short interest, and insiders are selling — exit this position entirely.
IONQ is down 58% with negative earnings, negative cash flow, 12% short interest, and insider selling — the thesis is broken, sell to protect remaining capital.

MSTR is down 52% and burning cash at an alarming rate as a leveraged Bitcoin bet — reduce your position size meaningfully because this kind of concentrated speculative exposure is dangerous in a stagflationary environment.
Micron at a PE of 4.3 with 256% revenue growth and nearly 6% free cash flow yield is genuinely cheap — consider adding on this pullback if you can stomach near-term volatility.
Google at a PE of 18.5 with 15% revenue growth and insider buying represents real value for a dominant business — worth adding a small amount at these levels.
